sections.label: Appearance
sections.description: Site-wide font for the storefront, product panels, cart and guest account.

fields.label: Theme font
fields.description: System uses each visitor's device font. Arial restores the previous storefront font. No external fonts are downloaded.

sections.label: Header
sections.description: Mobile navigation behavior. Site identity and menus are managed by WordPress.

fields.label: Mobile bottom navigation
fields.description: Show the bottom navigation on mobile. When disabled, search, cart and account appear in the header, as on desktop.

fields.label: Show gallery thumbnails
fields.description: Show the three circular previews beside the product gallery. Swipe remains available.

sections.label: My Account
sections.description: Choose which optional account destinations appear in the menu.

fields.label: Show Downloads in account menu
fields.description: Only hide the menu entry; downloads and existing permissions remain available.

sections.label: Footer
sections.description: Compact, one-line copyright and legal links.

fields.label: Hide footer on mobile
fields.description: Hide the footer on screens up to 700px. The desktop footer remains visible.

fields.label: Footer note
fields.description: Optional short note inline with the brand on desktop. Hidden on narrow mobile screens to keep one row.
